correctness.rationale: Addition theorem gives an exact seven-by-seven Gram for antipodal representatives; odd/even symmetries yield explicit 2-by-2 blocks. Exact fraction recurrence and an independently assembled rational Gram elimination verify all degrees 0..28, including the 14th-degree orbit functional. Classical Bernstein–Legendre inequality proves row-wise strict diagonal dominance for every degree >=29, so the claimed all-degree statement has a rigorous analytic tail. Checker and output are embedded.

value.rationale: The fourteen-point Lebedev cubature is a canonical minimally complex two-orbit spherical sampling grid. Its exact-degree harmonic interpolation determines spectral aliasing beyond standard degree-five quadrature precision. The nonmonotone reappearance of a missing direction at degree fourteen and the sharp persistent degree-fifteen threshold are structural results with a directly usable explicit linear constraint, not routine restatements of integration exactness.
